result:
I updated `src/exports/links.ts`. `DownloadLink` now has `expiresAt: string`, set to 7 days after creation as an ISO timestamp. The URL also carries it as `&expires=<url-encoded expiresAt>`. I haven't run or tested it.

This only puts the expiry in the link. The code that serves the download has to check `expires` and reject expired links, and I haven't looked at that.

Because the timestamp is part of the URL, anyone can edit it unless the server also signs it or ties it to the token.
